title: Initialize rust-ipfs client in reader main.rs
description: Replace MemIpfsStore with a real rust-ipfs 0.15.0 backed IpfsBlockStore in reader main.rs startup. The existing MemIpfsStore stays for tests. Why: ARTICLE/HEAD/BODY/XCID all call ipfs_store.get_raw_block(); without the real client, fetches always hit the empty in-memory store.
